text:
maria: Quick ask — can we schedule a mini throughput surge on the cb pool 'C' tomorrow morning? I want to validate the queue-shim changes in my PR before we land. should be low risk but want a short warmup and a 5m ramp to 2x baseline.
kevin: +1. Which PR number? also what's the plan for max_batch / max_tokens when we run?
maria: PR #432 (https://git.internal/r/redwood/pull/432). plan: keep max_batch_size=64, max_tokens=512, queue_window_ms=6 for first run, then try queue_window_ms=3 if steady.
sam: sounds good. can we patch the loadgen to emit variable seq lengths? previous runs got skewed by fixed 128 tokens.
maria: yes — i'll attach a loadgen command below.
maria: ```bash
loadgen --target http://cb.c.pool.internal:8080/generate \\n  --concurrency 16 --ramp 300 --duration 300 \\n  --seq-dist zipf --min-seq 16 --max-seq 512 --batch-window 6
```
jia: i'll queue the run on staging infra. send me the time window and i'll reserve nodes. also please post the PR link in the review thread so infra knows it's safe to kill if weird.
maria: plan is 09:30-10:00 PST tomorrow. low priority, retry once if flaky. i'll add the PR link.
kevin: quick note — when you test queue_window_ms=3, watch for small-batch fallback counts. last time we saw +40% small-batch increase which hurt p99. add the cb metric panel to the dashboard if not present.
maria: will do. which panel? name?
kevin: "cb: small-batch fallbacks / min-batch-rate" in runtime->batching. i can add an alert but want to observe first.
sam: for profiling, enable per-token timing logs (sampling 1/1000) so we don't blow the logging volume. pattern: `rt.per_token_ms.sample_rate=0.001`.
maria: noted. will enable sampling.
bench-bot: Scheduling bench: id=bench-1895004321, target=cb.c.pool.internal, start=1895080200, expected_duration=1800s, params={concurrency:16, max_batch:64, max_tokens:512, window_ms:6} :robot_face:
jia: reserved staging nodes s-cb-05,s-cb-06. i'll also pin the kernel to avoid noisy migrations during the run.
maria: thanks — i'll add a short checklist to the PR: 1) pin kernel, 2) enable per-token sampling, 3) run warmup 5m, 4) run 5m ramp, 5) capture cb metrics and perf traces.
kevin: can someone please comment on the PR with the run window? i'll try to be available for quick triage if p99 spikes.
maria: done. comment posted. PR also includes a tiny shim change: reduce queue head timeout from 12ms -> 8ms. expected to reduce latency tail without hurting throughput.
sam: small concern — if the shrink increases preemption, we might see head-of-line starvation. keep an eye on preempt-count.
maria: good call. i'll add preempt-count to the dashboard.
kevin: if we see regressions, fallback plan: revert shim and re-run with queue_window_ms=8 but keep other param changes.
jia: all set from infra. bench-bot will post results in this thread when complete.
bench-bot: Bench complete: id=bench-1895004321, status=success. summary: baseline_tps=1200, run_peak_tps=2380, p50=12ms, p95=48ms, p99=112ms, small_batch_rate=7% (baseline 4%). artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1895004321/*. Please review traces.
maria: thanks — putting next steps in the PR. initial look: throughput good, small-batch increase noticeable. will try queue_window_ms=3 run later today. :eyes:
